actions.name: Reconstruction
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech repairs its hull, healing an amount of Hit Points equal to 1d6 × the mech's tier. Once a mech has been repaired in this way, it can't benefit from this ability again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Builder Swarm
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech repairs the hull of a mech within 100 feet, healing an amount of Hit Points equal to 1d6 × the mech's tier. Once a mech has been repaired, it can't benefit from this ability again for 24 hours.

description.value:
Magical nanites repair a mech's hull.

@PPAbility[cost:3]{Reconstruction} Repair this mech's hull, healing 1d6 × the mech's tier Hit Points. A mech can't benefit from this again for 24 hours.

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Builder Swarm} Repair the hull of a mech within 100 feet, healing 1d6 × the mech's tier Hit Points. A mech can't benefit from this again for 24 hours.
